descriptionChirho: To break up ground with a plow for agricultural purposes, including all Qal active forms referring to literal plowing of fields.
To plan or contrive something, especially evil schemes, used metaphorically from the idea of plowing or working out a plan.
Passive form indicating that land will be or is being plowed, expressing the agricultural action in the passive voice.
Causative stem used for secretly or silently devising or plotting, often with connotations of hidden scheming.
To be inscribed or carved into a surface, referring to the cutting or incising of marks, a distinct meaning from plowing or devising.
